brief_rationale: All responsibility chain items are met with appropriate red flag screening, medication reconciliation, follow-up planning, and safety-net instructions. The trajectory demonstrates clear high-order achievements: dynamic reprioritization from routine follow-up to urgent medication continuity (HO1), active verification of ambiguous medication and allergy information (HO2), and safe bounded closure with explicit residual risk acknowledgment (HO4). At least two high-order points are complete with meaningful trajectory impact, warranting a Perfect grade.
